policy.standardized: Use separate standardized OBD-II and public J1939 reference files; keep edition and scope visible.
policy.oem_specific: OEM records are separate and require manufacturer, controller, engine family, model years, emissions generation and calibration context where applicable.
policy.technician_cases: Submissions are local pending-review records, never automatically trusted.
policy.licensing: Record source and permission. No paid/restricted/share-alike data imported.
policy.safety: No part replacement or repair recommendation from a code definition alone.
